run_GTestColorTest: run the GTestColorTest suite to verify Google Test color output detection across TERM environments
test_SetEnvVar: test the SetEnvVar function to set or unset environment variables like GTEST_COLOR and TERM
test_UsesColor: test the UsesColor function to check if Google Test uses color output for a given TERM and flag
test_GTestColorTest_testNoEnvVarNoFlag: test color auto-detection behavior when neither GTEST_COLOR env var nor gtest_color flag is set
test_GTestColorTest_testAliasesOfYesAndN: test that yes/no aliases like true, false, 1, 0 work for the gtest_color flag
